description_expanded:
This stunning new vacation rental property is perfectly situated across a pedestrian path from Fonville Park and just steps from Raw and Juicy Restaurant. The first floor offers a very spacious private courtyard featuring ample covered seating, dining area and a summer kitchen for cooking outdoors. The private pool may be heated in the cooler months and also offers several seating options for soaking up the sun. Inside the home on the first floor, guests will find a large, open great room with plenty of seating, dining area and open kitchen with a large center island. This level also features a bedroom with a king-sized bed and private bath along with a power room off the main foyer. As you climb to the second floor, you will find the laundry area, a bedroom with four bunk beds (two lower, two upper) and private bathroom as well as the primary suite with a king-sized bed. One more staircase will take you to the third level with a powder room, wet bar and spacious outdoor terrace with additional seating and dining areas overlooking Alys Beach. The final bedroom is found up an outdoor staircase from the courtyard and features one king-sized bed and private bath. Parking for this home is located in an attached garage for two vehicles. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, the Silva Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
